Network · Regional Coordination

Rooted in the South. Six hubs and counting.

Headquartered in Kigali, with regional hubs across Africa, Latin America, and the Caribbean — and an architecture built so new hubs join the map, not a redesign.

Map loading — the full hub list is below.

Click a pin to jump to its hub. HQ Regional hub Planned

Kigali

Rwanda · Headquarters · East Africa

Global headquarters — institutional home, strategy and coordination, and host of the Kigali Knowledge Crossroads Week in October 2027.

Addis Ababa

Ethiopia · Regional hub · East & Horn of Africa

Gateway to continental institutions and the African Union ecosystem; policy and diplomacy engagement.

Dakar

Senegal · Regional hub · Francophone West Africa

Research, culture, and Atlantic partnerships across Francophone Africa and its diasporas.

Accra

Ghana · Regional hub · Anglophone West Africa

Enterprise, innovation ecosystems, and diaspora engagement across Anglophone West Africa.

São Paulo

Brazil · Regional hub · Latin America

University cooperation with GCUB and Latin American networks; host of the 2028 GPS Convening.

Martinique

The Caribbean · Regional hub

Caribbean node — island universities, cultural production, and climate resilience.

Wider Caribbean

The Caribbean · Planned

Extending Caribbean presence beyond the Martinique hub — in consultation with island universities and regional bodies.

Middle East

MENA · Planned

Consultations underway with regional universities and institutions.

South & Southeast Asia

Asia-Pacific · Planned

Exploratory partnerships across South and Southeast Asia.

Your region next

Extensible by design

The hub architecture — governance, coordination, and this map — is built to add new hubs without redesign. Propose a hub

What a hub does

Each regional hub operates under a Regional Coordinator responsible for regional strategy, partnerships, programming, stakeholder relations, and institutional development. Hubs plug regional universities, governments, enterprises, and communities into the global platform — and carry GPS programs into regional reality.
